findings.text: _gate_command_fault judges every word of the tests line that resolves under the temp root, so an honest gate command that only sets a cache or base temp there is refused at promotion, UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache and pytest --basetemp=/tmp/x being shapes present in 124 recorded manifests and in tests/test_a_passing_run_clears_its_arms.py:146; no repair verb re-points the tests line the way crew repair --arm re-points an arm, so that refusal has no remedy once the worker's turn has ended.

FULL_REVISION and is_full_revision restate the full-object-id predicate the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:267 and at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:217, differing only in refusing the 41-63 character lengths, so a predicate with existing owners is restated a fifth time rather than extended.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against a346fba4aa: b3737ed97e adds reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py and wires both readers at reports.py:2751 and promotion_checks.py:607, accepts an empty base arm at promotion_records.py:1210 and adds the arm verb at runs.py:2515; 41bbcbc687 narrows the arm rule and resolves a cited entry through the existing reports._citation_tokens at promotion_scope.py:283; 95047fc36e and 875c0cc2d5 are documentation only.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for a table-driven test running each fault through both readers with one reason, a test promoting a run whose only new test file has no base arm, a test re-pointing an arm through the verb with the as-delivered file kept, and a base-revision control; all four are in tests/test_a_manifest_is_refused_for_what_promotion_refuses.py:212 and tests/test_a_suite_arm_is_repointed_keeping_the_delivered_file.py:86, with the control recorded in negative-control-base-revision.log.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a manifest is refused while its worker is live for anything promotion would refuse; reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:75 states each rule once and both readers ask it, at reckon/crew/reports.py:2751 for the worker's crew check --manifest and at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:607 for the gate, so the reason a worker reads before delivery is the sentence promotion raises.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the run's manifest; it records status complete, commits b3737ed97e, 41bbcbc687, 95047fc36e and 875c0cc2d5, a node gate of 18 passed with EXIT=0 at 95047fc36e, and two suite arms over the affected selection carrying the same 109 failing ids at base and after.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The brief declares reckon, tests and the plan's evidence fragment; all 12 paths across the four commits, being 8 modules under reckon, 3 test files and 1 evidence fragment, lie inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_manifest_is_refused_for_what_promotion_refuses.py:256 withdraws the rule and shows the same delivery reading clean, and the same file at :327 shows the empty-arm pair in the refusing direction, but no test exercises the accepting direction of the temp-root rule at reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:152.
justifications.evidence: node-gate.log records 18 passed with EXIT=0 at 95047fc36e and I re-ran the same two test files at 875c0cc2d5 with 18 passed in 5.73s; negative-control-base-revision.log shows the base revision's check passing the prose row its promotion refuses.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:1-30 follows the surrounding module prose idiom and names every symbol by what it judges, with no plan, defect or stage label anywhere in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:607 raises the reason reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:75 states, so the worker's check and the gate refuse one defect with one sentence, though the commit-citation fault converged by teaching promotion to accept the entry rather than by refusing it.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:283 correctly reuses reports._citation_tokens, but reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:49 restates the full-object-id predicate already owned at reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:267 instead of extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every added or changed path lies inside the declared write paths, and the one edit to an existing test, tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py:63, replaces an abbreviated arm revision with a full object id the new rule requires.
